 sid=cats[codes]

# derive expected anonymized name from order first occurrence
orig_order=list(pd.unique(filt.SampleID))
mp={o:f'Patient_{i+1:03d}' for i,o in enumerate(orig_order)}
exp=filt.SampleID.map(mp).to_numpy()
print('sample order matches',np.array_equal(exp,sid), 'n samples',len(orig_order))
# compare barcode suffixes all rows
orig_suffix=np.array([c[len(s)+1:] for c,s in zip(filt.Cells.astype(str),filt.SampleID.astype(str))])
h5_suffix=np.array([c[len(s)+1:] for c,s in zip(idx,sid)])
print('barcodes same',np.array_equal(orig_suffix,h5_suffix), 'mismatches',np.sum(orig_suffix"'!=h5_suffix))
print('"'\\nMappings candidates:')
for p in ['Patient_005','Patient_006','Patient_007','Patient_018','Patient_040']:
 orig=orig_order[int(p[-3:])-1]
 x=filt[exp==p]
 print(p,orig,len(x),'Disease',x.Disease.value_counts().to_dict(),'Tissue',x.Tissue.value_counts().to_dict(),'Cell DC',int((x.CellName=='DC').sum()),'prop',round((x.CellName=='DC').mean()*100,4))
